article: 「日本人ファースト」について思うこと
scope: Compared the complete Japanese article and twelve translations. Fact-checked the worker counts, public-assistance figures, foreign-crime category, craft-industry series, and population framing against official sources. Removed unidentified poll figures, unsupported crime-rate comparisons, industry percentages, and causal predictions; corrected terminology, dates, and source links. Preserved the author's argument as opinion.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date, kept the original 2026-01-23 publication date, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Replaced the mistaken 2024 foreign-worker count with official October 2024 and October 2025 reported counts; removed unverified sector growth figures and price predictions.
Corrected the public-assistance statistic to the MHLW FY2024 household-head measure and clarified its denominator and scope.
Removed unsupported foreign-crime shares, per-capita rates, and age comparisons; clarified the NPA's narrower 'visiting foreign nationals' category.
Replaced the unsupported current traditional-craft headcount with a sourced 1979–2013 series and removed nationality-based causal claims.
Removed unidentified 42%/38% polling figures and reframed unsupported expert-consensus and population superlatives as the author's view or removed them.
Corrected the Russian translation that mistranslated public assistance as unemployment benefits; added localized reference labels and five official source links.
